edge_explainer: THE DECISIVE CAUSE-CHECK. (1) On 2026-03-31 Marvell sold 2,000,000 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred to NVIDIA for $2.0B cash — $1,000 stated value, conversion price ~$91.8355, max 21,778,000 common, pari passu with common, votes as-converted (8-K 0001193125-26-134462, Items 3.02/5.03). (2) On 2026-06-01/02 NVIDIA's CEO publicly called Marvell 'the next trillion-dollar company'; MRVL gapped from a $219.43 close to a $253.46 open and closed $290.79 — +32.5% on 112.6M shares against ~30M normal — with NO 8-K and no company release that day, then ran to an intraday $329.88 by 6/04. (3) Added to the S&P 500 on 2026-06-22 (index-inclusion flow). (4) A continuous stream of Rule 144 and Form 4 filings from 6/15 through 8/03. (5) -31.1% in July. RULING: neither de-rate nor derailment — the retrace of a promotional spike created by a related party. The 'own 3-year high' the screen measures -40% against was printed on a sentence from the holder of $2B of preferred struck at $91.84, whose paper was worth ~$6.9B at that high and is still worth ~$4.28B (+114% in four months) tonight. NEW FACTOR-COSTUME MODE — not sector beta but related-party endorsement plus index-inclusion flow. TWO GATES THAT WOULD HAVE CAUGHT IT: (a) age-of-high gate, reject when the 3y high is younger than ~180 days (MRVL 60 days, ARM 46, KLAC 33); (b) promotional-high gate, flag when the 3y high was set within 5 sessions of a >3-sigma single-day advance with NO corresponding company filing. EXHAUSTED fired and was RIGHT — +220.6% off the 52w low, the most extreme in the cohort. THE AI-BREAK CONFLICT: MRVL is the purest exposure in the set. Management's own driver list — 800G/1.6T optics, 51.2T Ethernet switches, NPO/CPO optical, datacentre interconnect, custom XPU — is entirely line items inside hyperscaler and neocloud capital budgets. No consumer leg, no government leg, no services annuity. Aggravated by structure: $4,961M debt, goodwill $13,884M against $18,216M of equity (76% of book) from Celestial AI and XConn closed Feb-2026 at cycle-peak prices, and the NVIDIA preferred sitting as-converted above it. Fundamentals are genuinely strong — Q1 FY27 revenue $2,418M +28%, Q2 guide $2.70B +35%, FY27 and FY28 outlooks 'significantly raised' — but GAAP EPS was $0.04 against $0.80 non-GAAP, a 20x gap. At 21.1x TTM sales against a 9.0-31.1x 3y range, the -40% priced out the soundbite premium and none of the break.
